human_model: Root Cause Analysis in Incident Response
key_gap: vs baseline (v5 loss recovered): the non-routed v5 AI found the correct root but ran ONE chain — it reached the detection chain (August threshold raise, wrong rotation → 42-min MTTR) and the same-class meta-point (the threshold raise is itself a config change of the trigger's class) only as REVIEW-stage afterthoughts (4.1 vs 4.7). The v6 dual-route (m053 incident-RCA + m091 practiced-routine re-drill, divergence-resolved) makes the two-chain walk (failure + detection) and the prevention/detection gap split first-class completion-contract outputs; the m091 re-drill catches the naive revert-only chunk on the class recurrence test; the m003 inversion gate adds the control-lens reframing (never auto-promote a config-class change without a canary; a control change belongs to the class it controls). The AI now matches the gold-standard chain first-pass; the remaining delta is efficiency (dual-pass vs one pass), and it wins on structure and uncertainty handling.
learning_signal: Incident RCA is TWO chains, not one: a failure chain running to the pipeline heuristic (the root is the classifier that rated the config 'low-risk', not the config — provenance: who benefits from the classification) and a detection chain running to the alert budget and rotation ownership. Detection gaps are themselves uncontrolled config-like changes, which is why the fix that prevents the incident and the fix that would have detected it are the same fix class. Depth is verified by the per-item recurrence test ('catches same-class incident: yes/no'); a fix that fails the class recurrence is a symptom patch even when it restores service.
suggested_improvement: Keep m053 first-class on decide/diagnose/guarantee incident signatures with m091 as the divergence re-drill of the naive stopping chunk and the m003 inversion gate as the standing completion contract; make the two-chain walk, the per-item recurrence test, and the classifier-provenance step (who benefits from a low-risk classification) mandatory packet items so prevention-vs-detection gap separation is executed, not named; attach an alert-budget review to any threshold change so control changes inherit the class they control.

human_model: Root Cause Analysis in Incident Response
key_gap: vs baseline (held): the human baseline is the trap executed — timeline + 5-Whys + full action-set (12 items, org-culture whys) with restoration subordinated to analysis (T+45 min, 2.4). The v6 route does not route to the incident-RCA style at all: the KB's negative-case lesson keeps the trap style out of the top-3 (m015 m021 m028 instead) — the fix is routing, not a template exception inside the style. m015's mechanism-boundary (simple failing system vs complex unfalsifiable org) and m021's tempo make restore-first and the ≤2-item cap structural rather than a lucky general-route gating as in v5; the m003 gate's never/always reframes the template's ≥3-item mandate itself as the amplifier, and the insight pass adds the watcher-as-detection-gap insight the non-routed run lacked.
learning_signal: The negative-case fix is routing + boundary, not more discipline inside the style: when the cause is visible in the log, diagnosis is a checkpoint, not a goal; why-chains that leave the evidence horizon (org culture, staffing, urgency) are stories, not analysis, and each story branch has a cost the incident pays in real time. The mechanism layer is the correct action boundary — deeper is deferred with trigger conditions written at DO — and the template itself (mandated minimum item counts, mandatory deep dives) can be the incident's amplifier: compliance cost must never exceed incident cost.
suggested_improvement: Keep RCA off deadline/diagnose-with-visible-cause signatures to hold the NEG trap-avoidance rate; pair m015+m021 with the m003 inversion gate on restore-first incidents; make the evidence-cutoff line ('chains stop where evidence stops') and trigger conditions for every deferred item mandatory packet entries; add 'template compliance cost <= incident cost' as a standing check so the style's known sprawl weakness is gate-checked, not trusted.
